column1: # The #230 replay: the one ours-only missing_backpointer case of main control
# run 38698985871, originally dispatched at 91a47a206cb4ada85cb322775af438a60b03eb6e,
# 80 cases per fixture from seed 0, reference 1.39.7). Its report names
# default.img seed 55, node at byte 2752512 (32768 bytes), reference clean
# (exit 0). The replay keeps the reference's backpointers and extents
# listings and raw fsck -n of default.img unchanged and mutated, so the
# displaced key's lookup is judged by the reference's own view. The original
# fixtures artifact expired, so replay now uses the frozen durable fixture
# release and digest below; the old run and asset IDs remain as provenance.
# The replay corroborates the case from those listings: control run
# 38761923257 shows the extent's pointer at 0:236:20 in both images and its
# backpointer moved from bucket=0:236:20 suboffset=0 to bucket=0:236:19
# suboffset=65281, so the reference lists no backpointer where this crate
# looked. The finding is not a lookup false positive; the reference's fsck
# exits clean regardless.
